turns.text:
ok wait can you make this text to paolo sound less passive aggressive lol. its almost midnight and i keep rewording it

"hey man no worries about last time!! i know u close late thu-sat so i can just do all the prep myself again, totally fine. but if u can maybe confirm a time for prep tmrw?? need everything rolled before the saturday table and its like 150 lumpia. also i still gotta pay u back the 260 for the shrimp u fronted, will get u soon 🥢"

Happy to help. The main things making it read passive-aggressive are "no worries" followed by "I'll just do it all myself again," and the pile of question marks. Here's a cleaner version:

"Hey man, hope the closing shift wasn't too brutal. I know you're on late Thursday through Saturday, so I'm trying to plan around that. Can you confirm a prep time for tomorrow? I need about 150 lumpia rolled before the Saturday table at the cafe counter, so a firm start time really helps. Also, I haven't forgotten the $260 for the shrimp you fronted. I'll get it to you [date or how you'll pay]. Thanks for covering that 🥢"

It asks for the time directly, keeps the friendly tone, and gives the payback its own clear line. Fill in the bracket with a real date if you can, since that reads more reliable than "soon."
ok actually can u also give me a solo timed plan for the 150 in case paolo's running late again. short version, bullet list pls

Sure, here's a solo plan for about 150 lumpia. Adjust the start time to when you actually begin:

- 0:00-0:20: Set up. Thaw wrappers, prep station, start the oil heating.
- 0:20-0:50: Mix the filling and taste it.
- 0:50-2:20: Roll all 150. That's about 100 an hour, so cover the stack with a damp towel as you go.
- 2:20-3:20: Fry in batches, draining on racks.
- 3:20-3:50: Cool, pack, and clean up.

If Paolo shows up, you can start frying while he finishes rolling, which saves about an hour. Want me to turn this into a checklist with checkboxes?
nah this is good. sige thanks boss 🔥
Anytime! Good luck with the batch tomorrow. Send the text and get some sleep before the early start.
